reason: The plugin primarily integrates externally hosted Markdown skills into the DeepSeek Harness skill registry and also provides Windows completion notifications.

summaries.zh: 将 GitHub 或其他 Markdown 地址中的外部技能导入 DeepSeek Harness，并在 Windows 上提供任务完成通知。
summaries.en: Imports externally hosted GitHub or Markdown skills into DeepSeek Harness and provides completion notifications on Windows.

capabilities: Imports external SKILL.md content from GitHub or direct Markdown URLs into the Harness skill registry
Displays Windows completion notifications when a root agent becomes idle
Requires network access to api.github.com for GitHub-hosted skill loading
